proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: eBay blocks Apify's shared datacenter proxy IPs. Select the RESIDENTIAL proxy group (requires that add-on on your Apify plan) for reliable results. By default the actor forces a US exit IP (countryCode: US) so prices are always returned in USD instead of a localized currency; override countryCode here if you need a different country.
